brief: Compare amounts expressed for different time periods on a common time basis.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Match the period"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Iguala el periodo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Iguale o período"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare amounts expressed for different time periods on a common time basis.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Compare costs over the same length of time.
instruction.misconception: Compare a weekly quote directly with a monthly quote.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.
